name: House of Friendship Emergency Food Hampers
description: Emergency food hampers for individuals and families in need. Visit 807 Guelph Street Monday to Friday, 9:30 a.m.–4 p.m.; call ahead to book an appointment and bring valid identification. Hampers typically contain 3–5 days of food; availability and contents may vary.
summary_zh: 为有食物援助需要的个人和家庭提供紧急食品包。需提前致电预约并携带有效证件；食品包内容和供应情况可能变化。

name: Ray of Hope Marketplace Food Hamper
description: Monthly food hamper for individuals living within the downtown Kitchener boundary. Sign-up starts Monday–Thursday at 11 a.m.; service runs 11:30 a.m.–2 p.m. Spots are limited and first-come, first-served. No appointment is needed. Call to confirm current eligibility and availability.
summary_zh: 为居住在基奇纳市中心服务范围内的人士提供每月食品包，名额有限、先到先得，无需预约。出发前请确认资格和余量。

name: Cambridge Food Bank Community Pantry
description: Emergency food hampers for residents of Cambridge and North Dumfries, generally once per calendar month. In-person pickup is available without an appointment during listed hours. Bring identification, proof of Cambridge or North Dumfries address, and reusable bags. Food-locker and delivery options may be available by arrangement.
summary_zh: 为剑桥市和 North Dumfries 居民提供紧急食品包，通常每月一次。无需预约，但需携带身份证明、当地住址证明和购物袋。
address: 54 Ainslie Street South, Cambridge, ON N1R 3K3

name: The Food Bank of Waterloo Region — Food Assistance Outreach
description: Call to find a nearby food hamper program and ask about delivery or after-hours locker pickup. The Food Bank is a distribution centre; food is not handed out at its office. The phone line is open Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to noon, except holidays.
summary_zh: 致电查询附近的食品援助项目，也可询问送餐或非营业时间取餐柜。食品银行的办公室不直接发放食品。热线工作日 9 点至中午开放，节假日除外。
address: Serving Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and surrounding townships; call for a nearby program

name: The Food Bank of Waterloo Region — Food Donation Drop-off
description: Accepts unopened, sealed, non-perishable food donations at the customer service door. Homemade food is not accepted. Check best-before and expiry guidance; fresh, frozen or prepared food donations should be arranged with the organization first. Regular drop-off hours Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; call ahead for holiday or seasonal hours.
summary_zh: 接收未开封、密封的常温食品捐赠；不接收自制食品。新鲜、冷冻或熟食捐赠需先联系确认。

name: Habitat for Humanity Waterloo Region ReStore — Waterloo
description: Accepts selected reusable furniture and household/building items in good condition. Upholstered sofas and chairs must be smoke-, stain- and tear-free; mattresses are not accepted. Drop-off donations are accepted; call ahead or request pickup for larger donations. Check the accepted-items list before travelling.
summary_zh: 接收符合条件、状态良好的家具和家居建材。软包沙发/椅子需无烟味、污渍和破损；不收床垫。大件捐赠请先联系。
address: 120 Northfield Drive East, Waterloo, ON N2J 4G8

name: Habitat for Humanity Waterloo Region ReStore — Cambridge
description: Habitat ReStore donation location. The regional accepted-items page lists selected reusable furniture and household/building materials; upholstered items must meet condition requirements and mattresses are not accepted. Check the current accepted-items list and call before transporting large donations.
summary_zh: Habitat ReStore 捐赠点。地区接收清单包含部分可再用家具及家居建材；软包家具须符合状况要求，不收床垫。运送大件前请先联系确认。

name: The Literacy Group of Waterloo Region — Kitchener
description: Free adult tutoring in reading, writing, math, digital skills and workplace basics. One-to-one and small-group options may be available. An intake assessment is required. Call to ask about eligibility, assessment appointments and the current class location.
summary_zh: 为成年人免费提供阅读、写作、数学、数字技能和职场基础辅导，可安排一对一或小组学习。参加前需评估，请致电了解资格、评估预约和上课地点。
address: 300 Victoria Street North, Unit 8, Kitchener, ON N2H 6R9

name: The Literacy Group of Waterloo Region — Cambridge
description: Free adult tutoring in reading, writing, math, digital skills and workplace basics. The Get SET program starts with an assessment. Call to ask about eligibility and current availability before visiting.
summary_zh: 为成年人免费提供阅读、写作、数学、数字技能和职场基础辅导。Get SET 项目需先进行评估；前往前请致电确认资格和名额。
address: 40 Ainslie Street South, 2nd Floor, Cambridge, ON N1R 3K1

name: Kitchener Public Library — Central Library Study Spaces
description: Study desks are available on a first-come basis. Some free study rooms require a library card and advance booking. Check the library website for current hours and holiday closures.
summary_zh: 自习桌位先到先用。部分免费学习室需要图书证并提前预约。开放时间和节假日安排请查看图书馆网站。
address: 85 Queen Street North, Kitchener, ON N2H 2H1

name: Waterloo Public Library — Main Library
description: The Main Library has quiet study carrels, bookable study rooms and free Wi-Fi. Check the library website for current hours, room availability and holiday closures.
summary_zh: 主馆设有安静自习座位、可预约学习室，并提供免费 Wi-Fi。开放时间、学习室空位和节假日安排请查看图书馆网站。

name: Idea Exchange — Queen's Square
description: Cambridge Public Library location with study and reading areas. Regular hours listed by the City: Monday–Thursday 9:30 a.m.–8:30 p.m., Friday–Saturday 9:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. and Sunday 1–5 p.m. Holiday schedules may differ.
summary_zh: 剑桥公共图书馆 Queen's Square 馆，设有学习和阅读区域。节假日时间可能不同，请查看官网公告。

name: Region of Waterloo Public Health — Dental Clinic (Waterloo)
description: Public Health dental care for Waterloo Region residents who meet the financial eligibility requirements and are not eligible for the Canadian Dental Care Plan. Eligible children 17 and under can receive basic services at no charge. Adult services are limited; contact Public Health to confirm eligibility and book.
summary_zh: 服务对象为居住在滑铁卢地区、符合收入要求且不符合加拿大牙科护理计划资格的人士。符合条件的 17 岁及以下儿童可免费接受基础牙科服务。成人服务有限，请联系确认资格并预约。

name: Region of Waterloo Public Health — Dental Clinic (Cambridge)
description: Public Health dental care for Waterloo Region residents who meet the financial eligibility requirements and are not eligible for the Canadian Dental Care Plan. Eligible children 17 and under can receive basic services at no charge. Adult services are limited; contact Public Health to confirm eligibility and book.
summary_zh: 服务对象为居住在滑铁卢地区、符合收入要求且不符合加拿大牙科护理计划资格的人士。符合条件的 17 岁及以下儿童可免费接受基础牙科服务。成人服务有限，请联系确认资格并预约。

name: Region of Waterloo Public Health — Vaccine Clinic (Kitchener)
description: Public Health offers vaccine appointments at its Kitchener clinic. Eligibility and available vaccines depend on the vaccine and your circumstances. Check the booking page for current availability and eligibility before travelling.
summary_zh: 地区公共卫生局在基奇纳提供疫苗预约。可接种疫苗和申请资格因疫苗种类及个人情况而异。出发前请查看预约页面，确认名额和资格。
address: 20 Weber Street East, Kitchener, ON N2H 1C3

name: Region of Waterloo Public Health — Vaccine Clinic (Cambridge)
description: Public Health offers vaccine appointments at its Cambridge clinic. Eligibility and available vaccines depend on the vaccine and your circumstances. Check the booking page for current availability and eligibility before travelling.
summary_zh: 地区公共卫生局在剑桥提供疫苗预约。可接种疫苗和申请资格因疫苗种类及个人情况而异。出发前请查看预约页面，确认名额和资格。

name: Region of Waterloo Public Health — Sexual Health Clinic (Waterloo)
description: Public Health offers confidential sexual health services, including STI testing and treatment, contraception, pregnancy-related services and sexual-health vaccines. The Waterloo clinic is at 99 Regina Street South. Appointments are required; eligibility and the right clinic depend on the service. Services are free, and most do not require a health card. Confirm the location when booking.
summary_zh: 公共卫生局提供保密的性健康服务，包括性传播感染检测与治疗、避孕、妊娠相关服务和性健康疫苗。Waterloo诊所地址为 99 Regina Street South。须预约；服务资格和就诊地点因项目而异，请预约时确认。服务免费，且多数项目无需健康卡。

name: Region of Waterloo Public Health — Sexual Health Clinic (Cambridge)
description: Public Health offers confidential sexual health services, including STI testing and treatment, contraception, pregnancy-related services and sexual-health vaccines. The Cambridge clinic is at 150 Main Street. Appointments are required; eligibility and the right clinic depend on the service. Services are free, and most do not require a health card. Confirm the location when booking.
summary_zh: 公共卫生局提供保密的性健康服务，包括性传播感染检测与治疗、避孕、妊娠相关服务和性健康疫苗。Cambridge诊所地址为 150 Main Street。须预约；服务资格和就诊地点因项目而异，请预约时确认。服务免费，且多数项目无需健康卡。
